privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Tikeo processes personal data when you use our ticketing and support platform.

collection.title: 1. Data We Collect
collection.content: We collect account and support information such as email, login, role, avatar, ticket content, attachments, and technical logs needed to secure and operate the service.

usage.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
usage.content: We use this data to authenticate users, manage support tickets, notify users about ticket events, improve service quality, and protect the platform against abuse.

legalBasis.title: 3. Legal Basis
legalBasis.content: Processing is based on service delivery, platform security, legitimate interests in support operations, and legal obligations when applicable.

retention.title: 4. Data Retention
retention.content: Account and ticket data are retained while the account is active and for a limited period afterward for compliance, dispute handling, and audit needs.

security.title: 5. Security Measures
security.content: We apply access controls, role-based permissions, and technical safeguards to protect data against unauthorized access, loss, or alteration.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
rights.content: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may request access, correction, deletion, or export of your personal data, and object to certain processing activities.

transfers.title: 7. Data Sharing and Transfers
transfers.content: Data is shared only with authorized administrators and support agents who need it to process tickets. We do not sell personal data.

children.title: 8. Age Requirement
children.content: The service is intended for users who can lawfully use an internal support platform. If you believe data was provided in error, contact an administrator.

privacy.contact: For privacy requests, contact your platform administrator through an authenticated support ticket.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of Tikeo as an internal support and ticket management platform.

eligibility.title: 1. Eligibility and Access
eligibility.content: You must use an authorized account and respect your assigned role permissions (client, agent, admin).

accounts.title: 2. Account Responsibility
accounts.content: You are responsible for the confidentiality of your credentials and for all actions performed through your account.

acceptableUse.title: 3. Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.content: You must not submit unlawful, abusive, malicious, or misleading content, and must not attempt to disrupt or bypass platform security.

userContent.title: 4. Ticket Content and Attachments
userContent.content: You remain responsible for information submitted in tickets. Submit only data necessary for support handling and avoid sensitive unrelated personal data.

serviceAvailability.title: 5. Service Availability
serviceAvailability.content: We aim to keep the platform available but may perform maintenance, updates, or temporary restrictions for operational and security reasons.

intellectualProperty.title: 6. Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content: Platform code, branding, and interfaces are protected. You may use the service only as permitted by your organization and these terms.

liability.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: To the extent permitted by law, the service is provided as-is for internal support workflows, and indirect damages are excluded.

termination.title: 8. Suspension and Termination
termination.content: Accounts may be suspended or revoked if terms are violated, security is at risk, or organizational access rights change.

changes.title: 9. Changes to Terms
changes.content: We may update these terms to reflect legal, technical, or operational changes. Continued use after updates means acceptance.

governingLaw.title: 10. Governing Rules
governingLaw.content: These terms are interpreted according to applicable internal policies and the mandatory laws applicable to your organization.

terms.contact: For questions about these terms, contact your administrator through the platform.
